cc:Work.dc:title: Material production and production routes
cc:Work.dc:description: Global production of (a) cement and clinker, (b) iron and steel, and (c) aluminium. Steel and aluminium totals are primary plus secondary production. Cement and clinker are distinct products and are not added. Each sector has its own vertical scale; markers show the supplied model years.
